title: Gantry module docs manifest
description: docs/manifest.json inside a Gantry module: the reading-order navigation for that module's pages, mounted under the module's section in `gantry docs`. Reuses the same page/group entry shape as the framework's own docs manifest. Omit the file to fall back to folder-derived nav (top-level pages listed directly, each subfolder becoming a group).

title.description: Optional section heading for this module in the docs sidebar; defaults to the module's manifest title.

entries.description: Ordered navigation for the module's single section: each item is a page or a group.

categories.description: Alternative to entries: split the module's docs into several named sub-sections. Use entries for the common single-section case.

oneOf.description: A page: a markdown file relative to the module's docs root, without the leading namespace (e.g. notifications.md or guide/setup.md).

title.description: Optional nav label; defaults to the page's first H1.

oneOf.description: A group: a collapsible heading nesting pages (and, if you must, further groups).

group.description: The group heading shown in the sidebar.
